Leg raises are a great way to get your legs moving and improve your overall fitness. Here are some simple instructions to help you get started:

1. Choose a comfortable position: Sit or stand up straight with your feet flat on the ground. Your knees should be slightly bent, but not locked.

2. Lift your legs: Slowly lift your legs up towards the ceiling, keeping your back straight and your core engaged. You should feel a stretch in your legs as you lift them.

3. Hold for a few seconds: Hold for a few seconds, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position. Repeat this exercise several times.

4. Repeat: Do this exercise several times, focusing on feeling the stretch in your legs and the tension in your core.

5. Progress: As you get stronger, you can gradually increase the number of repetitions or the duration of each exercise. Remember to listen to your body and adjust the intensity as needed.

Remember to always warm up before starting any exercise and cool down afterwards to prevent injury. Good luck and have fun! 🚀
